scoringBasisHint: Describe applicable tables, inspection scope, allowed-error sources, classification basis and inspection records. At most {{limit}} KiB of original text; saving does not authenticate references.
scoringExportFailed: Save As failed. The record remains verified and can be exported again.
scoringExportSaved: Saved as {{path}}. This export is an independent trial record, not an approved engineering deliverable.
scoringStale: The project revision or binding has changed. This record cannot be restored into the current project state.
scoringIntegrity: Integrity checks failed for stored input or results. This record cannot be restored.
scoringAcknowledge: I confirm saving this declared inspection trial. Evidence and classifications remain unverified; the result is not engineering approval or a signature.
scoringRateLimit: The trial workload limit for this time window has been reached. Retry the original request later.
scoringIntro: Score explicitly declared inspection records with exact arithmetic under the reviewed GB/T 24356—2023 clauses. Select a product and inspection stage, then supply its basis and declaration.
scoringEnvironment: The computation environment differs from the saved environment, preventing exact replay. This does not by itself mean the record was tampered with.
scoringExportCancelled: Save As was cancelled. No file was exported.
scoringLimit: An input, record-count or storage limit has been reached. Reduce the trial scope or use another project.
scoringValidation: The declaration does not meet the selected profile or stage contract. Check JSON, standard binding, unit type, unique IDs, scope states, evidence references, exact numeric strings and byte limits.
scoringInvalidResponse: The response version, project binding, original bytes, hashes or result structure are inconsistent. Results are not displayed.
scoringJsonHint: Original text is preserved without truncation or automatic repairs. Maximum {{limit}} KiB UTF-8; currently {{bytes}} bytes.
scoringExampleWarning: This template is structural, not project inspection evidence. Unknown values use null or pending status. Replace identifiers, references and actual records; never fill missing evidence with zero. It is not inserted or submitted automatically.
scoringNotFound: This trial record was not found in the project.
scoringPending: The save outcome is not confirmed. Original input and request identity are retained for retry. Starting a new draft clears local state only and does not delete a record that may already have been saved.
scoringLoading: Validating the declaration, scoring exactly and replaying the saved record…
scoringFailed: The request did not complete. A save may already have reached Runtime; retry reuses the original identity and content.
scoringNewDraft: Clear local draft and start again
scoringConflict: The request identity conflicts with stored content. Check history and the original request.
scoringVerified: Original bytes and hashes match the Runtime’s strict replay. This shows current local consistency, not authenticity of referenced materials, human classification or prior qualification.
scoringOffline: Runtime is offline. Current results and confirmation have been cleared. Reconnect to read history or submit.
scoringBoundary: Declared inspection trial only. Evidence references, defect classification and prior batch qualification are unverified. The result does not certify standards conformity, engineering acceptance or a professional signature.
scoringNormalizationHint: The original-text hash preserves whitespace and text order; the declaration hash binds the strictly parsed object. Inspect both to trace the exact calculation inputs.
scoringUnavailable: The trial service is unavailable. Check Runtime and retry.
scoringCancelled: This view has stopped waiting and will ignore late responses. A sent request may still finish saving; check history or retry the original request.
scoringLimits: Supports declared defect counts and precision values for these two profiles. It does not classify defects or derive mean-square error from adjustment residuals. Adjusted t≠1, the m>m0 formula branch, and aggregation with a precision item exactly at 60 are unsupported.
scoringResultBoundary: Calculated or declared conditions met describes only this input and stated scope. Partial scope, components, samples and batches are distinct.
scoringPartialGrade: Grade for this partial scope (not full product)
scoringExactHint: Values are exact numerator/denominator fractions. Grades use unrounded values. Rates are ratios, not rounded percentages.
scoringTrace: Inspect calculation trace and hierarchical weights

scopes.partial-declared-product-profile: Partial product scope only · Not full-product qualification
scopes.unresolved-declared-product-profile: Product scope has pending items · Full-scope conclusion incomplete
scopes.declared-sample-only: Declared detailed sample only · Not the actual batch
scopes.declared-batch-only: Declared batch and inspection stage only

metrics.diagnosticScoreUpperBound: Upper score bound from known records (diagnostic)

reasons.calculated: Exact calculation completed within the declared scope.
reasons.invalid_request: Request structure or source binding is invalid.
reasons.accuracy_domain: Error magnitude must be nonnegative and its allowed value positive.
reasons.accuracy_formula_outside_domain: No supported scoring formula for m>m0; no extrapolation or automatic A classification.
reasons.missing_accuracy_item: A precision item is missing; it cannot be omitted from the average.
reasons.multiple_accuracy_equality_60: A multiple-item precision group contains exactly 60; this aggregation branch is unsupported.
reasons.a_class_veto: A declared A-class defect independently vetoes qualification.
reasons.missing_a_evidence: A-class inspection evidence is unknown, not zero.
reasons.adjustment_coefficient: The adjustment coefficient must be positive.
reasons.adjusted_t_not_in_minimal_contract: This version supports t=1 only; adjusted coefficients are not automatically accepted.
reasons.mathematical_accuracy_requires_formula_3: Mathematical accuracy needs formula (3) precision declarations; zero defect counts cannot substitute a score of 100.
reasons.known_defects_already_below_60: Known defects already limit the maximum possible score to below 60.
reasons.missing_defect_evidence: A defect count is unknown and cannot be filled with zero.
reasons.subelement_below_60: The raw subelement score is below 60 and vetoes qualification.
reasons.child_below_60_or_a_veto: A below-60 or A-class child cannot be offset by weighted averaging.
reasons.pending_subelement: This applicable subelement is pending, not excluded.
reasons.empty_declared_scope: No inspection items are included in this scope.
reasons.missing_or_pending_unit: A declared sample member is missing or pending.
reasons.sample_has_failed_unit: The sample includes a known nonconforming unit.
reasons.overview_defects: Overview declarations have A>0 or B≥4 and are nonconforming.
reasons.overview_missing_evidence: Overview A/B count evidence is missing.
reasons.batch_prerequisite_failed: The prior batch qualification prerequisite is declared failed.
reasons.batch_prerequisite_missing: The batch prerequisite is unknown or actual batch membership is incomplete.
reasons.batch_fabrication_or_major_route_veto: Declared fabrication or major technical-route deviation vetoes the batch.
reasons.inspection_failed: Detailed or overview inspection is declared failed.
reasons.batch_veto_evidence_missing: Evidence for batch veto conditions is missing; absence cannot be assumed.
reasons.inspection_unresolved: Required inspection conclusions are unresolved; pending is not not-performed.
reasons.exact_arithmetic_budget: The exact-arithmetic resource budget was exceeded; no score is emitted.
reasons.weights_positive_sum_one: Weights must be positive and sum exactly to one.
reasons.invalid_qualified_unit_score: A declared qualified unit score must lie between 60 and 100.
reasons.accuracy_score_outside_formula_range: The precision score lies outside the formula range 60 to 100.
reasons.weight_shape: The number of weights does not match the scoring items.
reasons.defect_count: Defect counts must be bounded nonnegative integers.
reasons.child_below_60: A child below 60 cannot be averaged away.
reasons.invalid_sample_unit: The sample contains an invalid unit record.
